visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and light skin lies in bed, wearing a gray and white striped collared shirt. A white, fluffy dog licks her face, causing her to smile and point to her cheek. The background is a white pillow and bedding in bright, natural light. (2) The woman stands up and walks through a white-framed doorway, adjusting her hair with her hands. The scene transitions to a brightly lit indoor space with white shelving units filled with various skincare jars and bottles in the background. (3) Now wearing a white ribbed tank top, she holds a silver Dior Capture Totale bottle and a matching cream jar. She pumps clear serum onto her palm and massages it into her face with upward circular motions. Her skin appears glowy and hydrated. (4) She points to the area around her eyes, gesturing towards perceived dullness. She then holds a white Dior eye cream jar, applies small dots around her eye with her ring finger, and gently taps it in while looking directly into the camera. (5) She introduces a silver tube with a rounded metal applicator tip. She demonstrates using the applicator to massage the product under her eyes and towards her temples. She then uses her fingertips for a final lifting massage, showing a more awake expression. (6) Holding both Dior eye products, she speaks directly to the camera with an enthusiastic expression. She briefly shows her smartphone screen to emphasize screen-time eye strain. She ends by waving and smiling brightly.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, medium-tempo acoustic pop music begins with a bright guitar melody. A female voice speaks in a high-pitched, energetic tone, saying 'Good morning.' The sounds of a dog's panting and wet licking noises are clearly audible over the music. (2) The rustling sound of bedsheets and light footsteps follows. The speaker's voice maintains a friendly, conversational tone as she discusses her skin condition. The background music remains consistent in volume and tempo. (3) A sharp 'click' of a pump-top being pressed is heard, followed by a soft squelching sound of lotion. The speaker explains the technology in a professional yet approachable narrative style. The music bed provides a rhythmic foundation. (4) As she switches products, a 'pop' sound of a jar opening occurs. The sound of fingers gently tapping against skin is captured. Her voice lowers slightly in pitch to emphasize eye care, maintaining clear articulation. (5) A distinct metallic clinking sound is heard as she handles the eye-pen applicator. Rhythmic tapping and sliding sounds on skin accompany the description of the application process. The music swells slightly, adding a positive, uplifting atmosphere. (6) The vocal delivery becomes more rapid and persuasive as she provides a final recommendation. The video concludes with a soft, high-frequency 'ding' sound effect, synchronized with the final brand message, while the music fades out quickly.
